title: balance.json logic_hz=10 contradicts its own comment and ADR-2's 20Hz, doubling every tick-denominated duration
evidence:
balance.json:2   "_comment": "Balance catalog (GDD § Numerical Design, ADR-5, NFR5). The single source for every tunable number. All state-affecting values are int (ADR-10). logic_hz=20 -> 50ms/tick (ADR-2). ..."
balance.json:3   "logic_hz": 10,
demand.json:58   "start_tick": 1200,
demand.json:59   "duration_ticks": 1800,
detail: The loaded tick rate is 10Hz (100ms/tick), but the file's own header and ADR-2 specify 20Hz. Every tick-denominated duration is therefore 2x in wall-clock: the Streaming Surge lasts 1800 ticks = 180s at 10Hz vs the GDD/sprint-plan's ~90s at 20Hz.
recommended_fix: Set logic_hz to 20 to match the comment and ADR-2, or if 10Hz was deliberate playtest tuning, fix the stale comment and re-check surge/grace/lead tick counts (also update test_catalogs' eq(b.logic_hz, 10)).
